title: i'M NOT IMPRESSED
text: i'M NOT IMPRESSED. It comes beautifully boxed. It is definetely silky to touch and zips over your pillow easily. It's very cool to the touch,too. But... your head slides off your pillow during sleep so you wake up during the night with a bent neck. If you like to bunch your pillow between arm and cheek, it doesn't take long before pillow has slipped away and you're sleeping on a corner of your pillow with no support, nose burried in your bed sheets. I just slept on it one time and found myself chasing my pillow all night. I guess I'll just keep my wrinkles and sleep better with my ordinary pillow cases.

features: Hydroluna by Sutera is made from 100% premium pure long fiber Mulberry Silk infused with Hyaluronic Acid.

Fights Off Wrinkles and Crease Marks - As your skin gets older, it starts to lose moisture making it dry and less elastic causing wrinkles and crease marks to surface. Hydroluna focuses on getting Hyaluronic Acid into your skin to prevent it from drying up.

Supports the Structure of Healthy Skin - Hydroluna’s HA has been scientifically proven to help with redness as well as making skin smoother and supple. Since 50% of the HA your body produces is present in the skin, Hydroluna is feeding that HA to you when your body starts to slow down production.

Can Prevent Hair Breakage and Damage - Thanks to the premium silk Hydroluna is made of, your hair will glide over at night so you can wake up without knots or breakage. Hyaluronic Acid can also make your hair stronger and thicker so you don’t see strands of thin and broken hair all over the house.

A Luxury One-For-All Solution - Hydroluna combines the glamour of Premium 22 Momme Mulberry silk and Hyaluronic Acid to give you a comfortable night’s rest and a beauty treatment at the same time. This is a good skin regimen and alternative to expensive creams and lotions!
